title: Copy and Reuse
summary: Copy one button's commands onto another, tuck a button into a menu, and give a region another region's buttons.

steps.title: Step 1: Copy Turn's Commands onto Tilt
text: 1. Right-click Turn on the mannequin's head, and click Copy Commands.
2. Right-click Tilt, and click Paste Commands.

The mannequin is as Viewport Edit left it, in Viewport Edit, with a Hips region added. Tilt now drives what Turn does - the head's turn, at the same speed. Paste Commands copies only what a button drives: Tilt keeps its own name, look and place.

steps.title: Step 2: Make It Tilt
text: 1. Tilt's settings show under the tree. Under Left / Right, click Rotate Y on head to open its command.
3. Drag Tilt left and right: the head tilts to the side.
The head's Z points out of its face, so a turn about it tilts the head. Only what differs from Turn needed changing.

media.label: In the Kneady tab, then on the head

steps.title: Step 3: Tuck Tilt into Nod's Menu
text: 1. Click Nod, and in its settings tick Opens Menu.
2. Right-click Tilt, point at Move To, and click In Nod.
3. Click Nod: its menu opens, with Tilt in it.

A button can drag and open a menu at once: dragging Nod still nods, and a click shows the rest. Move To sends a button, with any menu of its own, into a menu or back to the region's own buttons - for the ones you use less.

media.label: In the Kneady tab, then on the head

steps.title: Step 4: Give the Hips the Chest's Buttons
text: 1. Right-click the chest, away from its buttons, and click Copy All Buttons.
2. Right-click the hips, and click Paste All Buttons.
The hips take Bend and Twist, arranged as the chest's were, in place of their own; they keep their own name, faces and color. The copy is on the system clipboard, so it pastes into another file too.

media.label: On the chest, then the hips

steps.title: Step 5: Point Them at the Hips
text: 1. Click Bend on the hips. Under Up / Down, click Rotate X on chest to open its command, click Bone, type hips and press Enter.
2. Click Twist on the hips, and do the same under Left / Right.
3. Drag Bend on the hips: they bend.
A copy keeps what it drives - bones by name, even pasted into another file - so the hips' buttons turned the chest until you changed what differs. Click Viewport Edit again when you're done.

media.label: On the hips, and in the Kneady tab
